main_text.p: liæ rege esse, & concilii sedem primæ-vam ad Thermopylas in Thessalià fuis-se: deinde istinc in Phocidem, ubi po-steris temporibus fuit, esse translatam.

Accedit verisimilitudo sententiæ eidem quoque ex populis, quos primum concilii hujus participes fecisse Amphictyonem Pausanias docet numero x, quorum plurimos aut Thessalos fuisse, aut Thessaliæ proximos, eidemque posteris sæculis etiam accensos esse conslat; nimirum Dolopes, Ænianes, Magnetes, [illegible, ~2 letters]thioras Maleenses, ipsos Thessalos, [illegible, ~2 letters]rienses: quos jus Amphictyonicum huc tenuisse tempore suo, Æschines in [illegible, ~1 letter]ratione [illegible] oftentat, licet pro Dolopibus Perrhæbos, pro [illegible, ~2 letters]ianibus Aetæos videatur nomina-re. Vsitatum autem est, proximos quosque populos in hujusmodi concilia loco ipsis commodo & vicino primum coire. Præter hos verò in societate hac Amphictyonicâ jam inde ab initio fuêre [illegible]ocenses, Bœoti, Locri Iones, inter quos etiam Athenienses censebantur. iuro otQuando, & à quo sedes in Phocem tranflata fit, affirmare prom-imo ótum non est: quanquam ad Acrisium iuro otem illo tempore præpotentem in imo óciâ id referre forsan non fuerit ab-dum. Quinimò turbat nos heic idem

page.notes: Left margin notes are cut off or faint; the readings marked illegible are uncertain. The note fragments "iuro o/t" and "imo ó/m" at the lower left are very faint and their reading is doubtful. The right edge strip (Pau, De, m, co, br, ch, tu, cu, etc.) is the neighbouring page and is excluded. Long s has been written as plain s throughout, so "conslat" and "Thessalià" follow the print's letter forms as read; "conslat" is doubtful. Lines in the left column near the notes are partly obscured by print bleed-through.
